pages.text: The Potion Table: sample (purity >=25) + solids + Life Energy -> Akaishi Potion.$(br2)$(2,4)Permanent$(0): +15 permanent adaptation to implanted organs, no side effects.$(br)$(2,4)Breakthrough$(0): organ effects x1.5 but more rejection and random side effects (worse at low purity).
Potions inherit the sample source and purity; drinking affects implanted non-native organs.$(br)Breakthrough works only once - beware low-purity samples!
